note: promptGuidelines for `subagent` are captured at registration; upstream splices the same live array at session_start (adds the authenticated model catalog as the last line and swaps the model-choice bullets when task preferences exist).

tools.name: subagent_send
tools.label: Send Persistent Task
tools.description: Deliver one follow-up task to an idle persistent specialist. Busy specialists reject tasks; no queue is kept.

tools.name: subagent_stop
tools.label: Stop Persistent Specialist
tools.description: Stop a persistent specialist after its active task finishes.

tools.name: subagent_cancel
tools.label: Cancel Subagent
tools.description: Cancel a running non-persistent subagent, including an interrupted one. The host stops its process and delivers exactly one cancelled result, with no model fallback, retry, or recovery. Do not poll for it. A plain pane closes. A worktree child keeps the workspace, checkout, commits, and manifest. Returns confirmed, requested (launch still in flight), unconfirmed (still running; call again), or already-terminal. Persistent specialists are rejected; use subagent_stop.
tools.promptSnippet: Cancel a running non-persistent subagent; one cancelled result arrives later

name.description: Exact unambiguous running subagent display name

tools.name: subagents_list
tools.label: List Subagents
tools.description: List subagent role definitions, live persistent specialists, and the supervision mode.
tools.promptSnippet: List the subagent role definitions available to launch

tools.name: subagent_resume
tools.label: Resume Subagent
tools.description: Resume a saved subagent session in a new terminal pane, to continue a cancelled run or send follow-up work. It does not reattach a retained worktree; continue that work in the existing workspace. The call returns at once and the result arrives later as a message. Do not poll for it.
tools.promptSnippet: Resume a saved subagent session in a new pane; its result arrives later as a new message

sessionPath.description: Path to the session .jsonl file to resume

name.description: Display name for the terminal tab. Default: 'Resume'

autoExit.description: Exit after the response. Defaults to true; set false to leave the session open for the user.
